title.narrative: Building Happy Schools for Transformation of Education and Sustainable Development in Viet Nam

description.narrative:
This project aims to transform education in Viet Nam by establishing Happy Schools that promote happiness and well-being through whole-school and whole-sector approaches. Aligned with UNESCO’s global framework, overarching principles include equity, inclusiveness, sustainability, participatory implementation, evidence-based decision-making, and stakeholder collaboration.
At its core, a comprehensive Happy Schools model, supported by evidence-based approaches and a robust monitoring framework, will be piloted, refined, and advocated for broader adoption. Capacity-building will equip educators with practical tools and foster collaboration through a community of practice. Public awareness will grow via communication campaigns and a networking platform.
